prompt_inputs.identity: Barbarians meet danger with raw nerve, hard-earned instinct, and a refusal to yield. Some are wanderers shaped by harsh frontiers, others champions whose fury rises when friends or homelands are threatened. In battle, they surge past fear and pain, turning reckless momentum into devastating force.

Bards turn story, rhythm, and daring into tools that can sway a crowded hall or steady companions in the thick of danger. They are wanderers, performers, and keen observers who collect secrets as readily as songs. In a crisis, a well-timed verse or cutting remark can change the course of an entire encounter.

Clerics stand where mortal need meets sacred purpose, carrying conviction into crypts, courts, and battlefields alike. Some are humble caretakers, others stern judges or blazing champions, but all draw courage from vows larger than themselves. Their presence can steady frightened companions, turn back darkness, and make even desperate causes feel worth defending.

Druids are stewards of wild places, reading the weather, soil, and seasons as closely as any scholar reads a book. They wander beyond city walls to mend blighted groves, guard ancient paths, and answer threats that upset nature’s hard-won balance. A druid’s craft is patient, adaptable, and often underestimated—until the land itself seems to rise in defense.

Fighters thrive where nerve, training, and a steady hand decide the day. Some are disciplined soldiers, others hardened duelists, guards, rebels, or wandering champions, but all learn to meet danger head-on. In the crush of battle, they turn practiced technique and stubborn resolve into a weapon as reliable as steel.

Monks turn relentless discipline into breathtaking action, meeting danger with calm focus and sudden force. Some train in secluded halls, others learn amid crowded streets or harsh roads, but all refine body and mind into a single purpose. In battle, they move like a held breath released—swift, precise, and difficult to pin down.

Paladins are sworn champions who turn conviction into action, standing where danger presses hardest. Whether serving a crown, a cause, or a private vow, they meet cruelty with disciplined courage and refuse to abandon those in their care. Their presence can rally wavering allies and make even hardened foes reconsider the cost of defiance.

Rangers thrive where roads fade and the wild keeps its own counsel. They are patient trackers, sharp-eyed scouts, and stubborn guardians who learn every spoor, storm sign, and hidden trail. Whether guiding companions through hostile country or stalking a dangerous quarry, a ranger turns hard terrain and long odds into familiar ground.

Rogues thrive where quick wits matter more than loud steel, slipping through guarded halls, crowded markets, and tangled intrigues with equal ease. Some are scouts, swindlers, burglars, or hired blades; others simply learned that survival favors the observant and the bold. In a tense moment, a rogue turns a distraction, a shadow, or a whispered secret into an opening.

Sorcerers wield magic that rises from within, shaped by strange bloodlines, uncanny accidents, or a soul marked by the impossible. Their power answers instinct and emotion as readily as study, bursting forth in dazzling, dangerous displays. A sorcerer thrives where control is tested, turning raw inner fire into miracles, menace, and spectacle.

Some seekers bargain for power; others inherit a whisper that refuses to fade. A warlock carries a strange ally’s influence like a brand, turning forbidden promises and uncanny insight into force on the battlefield. They suit players drawn to dangerous bargains, eerie mysteries, and magic that always seems to have an agenda.

Wizards pursue the hidden grammar of reality, turning patience, curiosity, and disciplined study into astonishing feats. Some are ivory-tower scholars, others battlefield savants or restless collectors of forbidden theories, but all learn that a well-prepared mind can make the impossible seem inevitable.
